title: Fix website deployment accessibility issue

requirements.text: Diagnose and fix the deployment configuration preventing the website from loading or being accessible at www.ols.in or the default Internet Computer canister URL
acceptanceCriteria: Website loads successfully when accessed via browser
Frontend assets are served correctly from the canister
Backend canister is accessible and responding to queries
No CORS or network connectivity errors in browser console
DNS configuration for www.ols.in is properly set up (if custom domain is being used)

requirements.text: Verify that the dfx.json configuration correctly defines frontend and backend canisters with proper source directories and build settings
acceptanceCriteria: dfx.json includes both frontend and backend canister definitions
Frontend canister points to correct dist directory after build
Backend canister references the correct main.mo file
Asset canister configuration includes necessary file types (html, css, js, images)

requirements.text: Ensure frontend build process completes successfully and generates deployable assets in the dist directory
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build completes without errors
dist directory contains index.html, compiled JavaScript bundles, and CSS files
All imported assets and images are included in build output
Build process properly handles React Router configuration for single-page application

requirements.text: Verify backend canister deploys successfully with all Motoko code compiling without errors
acceptanceCriteria: Backend Motoko code compiles without syntax or type errors
All public methods are accessible via Candid interface
Canister can handle basic queries and updates

constraints: Must maintain existing mobile OTP authentication system
Must preserve all existing listing and user data structures
Must keep INR currency formatting intact
Do not modify the single-actor backend architecture
nonGoals: Changing the UI design or layout
Updating domain configuration beyond fixing deployment issues
